sources.title: Model Reference — Cosmos - NVIDIA Documentation Hub
sources.snippet: Model Reference # Cosmos 3 is available as Cosmos3-Super (64B), Cosmos3-Nano (16B), and Cosmos3-Edge (4B). The model family also includes task-specific variants: Cosmos3-Super-Text2Image, Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video, their four-step Text2Image and Image2Video variants, plus Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID and Cosmos3-Edge-Policy-DROID. See the Model Matrix for hardware guidance and model selection ...

sources.title: Cosmos3-Edge Design — TensorRT Edge-LLM
sources.snippet: The only model-specific pieces on the export side are the Nemotron-H squared-ReLU MLP (Cosmos3ReasonerCausalLM) and the mapping from the checkpoint’s native flat schema to the shared decoder names.
